name: Grandmaster Arena
description: Full-stack 3D/2D multiplayer chess arena with World League, Moradabad School/College/Companies Leagues, 5 AI levels, real-time WebSocket rooms, Firebase Google Sign-In, and Cloud SQL PostgreSQL.

requiredEnvVars.name: PORT
requiredEnvVars.description: Injected automatically by hosting platform (e.g. 8080 or 3000)

requiredEnvVars.name: SQL_HOST
requiredEnvVars.description: PostgreSQL host or Cloud SQL Auth Proxy socket path

requiredEnvVars.name: SQL_ADMIN_USER
requiredEnvVars.description: PostgreSQL admin user for Drizzle schema push

requiredEnvVars.name: SQL_ADMIN_PASSWORD
requiredEnvVars.description: PostgreSQL admin password for Drizzle schema push

requiredEnvVars.name: RAZORPAY_KEY_ID
requiredEnvVars.description: Optional live Razorpay key ID for real payments

recommendedHostingPlatforms.name: Railway
recommendedHostingPlatforms.notes: Supports Node 22, WebSockets, and managed PostgreSQL directly.

recommendedHostingPlatforms.name: Google Cloud Run
recommendedHostingPlatforms.notes: Supports Node 22, Cloud SQL PostgreSQL, and WebSockets.

recommendedHostingPlatforms.name: Fly.io / VPS
recommendedHostingPlatforms.notes: Run npm run build && npm start behind HTTPS reverse proxy with /ws WebSocket upgrade.

firebaseAuthNotes.actionRequiredForExternalDomain: Add your new published domain to Firebase Console -> Authentication -> Settings -> Authorized domains so Google Sign-In works on the new URL.
